# Grouping guide

Group each change under exactly one of these headings, in this order:

- **Breaking changes**: anything that requires the user to act on upgrade.
- **Features**: new commands, flags, or supported formats.
- **Fixes**: behaviour corrections that need no user action.
- **Internal**: refactors and test-only changes; omit these from the notes.

Try to keep each entry to one sentence when possible. Link the pull request
number at the end of the line.
